api_token.description: API token for authentication. Can also be set via POCKETID_API_TOKEN environment variable.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Pocket-ID instance. Can also be set via POCKETID_BASE_URL environment variable.

skip_tls_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Default is false. Only use this for development/testing.

timeout.description: HTTP client timeout in seconds. Default is 30.

block.description:
Interact with Pocket-ID OIDC provider. Pocket-ID is a simple and easy-to-use OIDC provider
that allows users to authenticate with their passkeys to your services.

accent_color.description: Accent color used in the UI.

allow_own_account_edit.description: Whether users can edit their own account ("true" or "false").

disable_animations.description: Whether to disable UI animations ("true" or "false").

email_api_key_expiration_enabled.description: Whether API key expiration emails are enabled ("true" or "false").

email_login_notification_enabled.description: Whether login notification emails are enabled ("true" or "false").

email_one_time_access_as_admin_enabled.description: Whether admins can use one-time access email links ("true" or "false").

email_one_time_access_as_unauthenticated.description: Whether unauthenticated users can request one-time access email links ("true" or "false").

email_verification_enabled.description: Whether email verification is enabled ("true" or "false").

emails_verified.description: Whether user emails are considered verified ("true" or "false").

home_page_url.description: URL of the application home page.

id.description: Fixed identifier of the application configuration singleton.

ldap_admin_group_name.description: LDAP group name granting admin privileges.

ldap_attribute_group_name.description: LDAP attribute for the group name.

ldap_attribute_group_unique_identifier.description: LDAP attribute for the group unique identifier.

ldap_attribute_user_display_name.description: LDAP attribute for the user display name.

ldap_attribute_user_email.description: LDAP attribute for the user email.

ldap_attribute_user_first_name.description: LDAP attribute for the user first name.

ldap_attribute_user_last_name.description: LDAP attribute for the user last name.

ldap_attribute_user_profile_picture.description: LDAP attribute for the user profile picture.

ldap_attribute_user_unique_identifier.description: LDAP attribute for the user unique identifier.

ldap_enabled.description: Whether LDAP integration is enabled ("true" or "false").

ldap_skip_cert_verify.description: Whether to skip LDAP certificate verification ("true" or "false").

ldap_soft_delete_users.description: Whether to soft-delete users removed from LDAP ("true" or "false").

require_user_email.description: Whether a user email is required ("true" or "false").

signup_default_custom_claims.description: JSON object of custom claims assigned to users created via signup.

signup_default_user_group_ids.description: JSON array of user group IDs assigned to users created via signup.

smtp_from.description: Email address used as the sender.

smtp_skip_cert_verify.description: Whether to skip SMTP certificate verification ("true" or "false").

block.description: Manages the global application configuration of a Pocket-ID instance. This is a singleton resource: only one should exist per instance. Any attribute left unset inherits the current server-side value, and removing the resource from configuration leaves the live configuration untouched.

allowed_user_groups.description: List of user group IDs that are allowed to use this client. If empty, all users can use this client.

callback_urls.description: List of allowed callback URLs for the OIDC client.

client_id.description: The client ID to use for the OIDC client. If not set, one will be generated. Must be between 2 and 128 characters.

client_secret.description: The client secret. Only available during resource creation for non-public clients.

audience.description: The expected audience of the federated identity token.

issuer.description: The issuer of the federated identity token.

jwks.description: Optional JWKS used to validate the federated identity token.

subject.description: The expected subject of the federated identity token.

federated_identities.description: List of federated identities (workload identity federation) allowed to authenticate as this client.

has_logo.description: Whether the client has a logo configured.

id.description: The ID of the OIDC client.

is_public.description: Whether this is a public client (no client secret). Defaults to false.

launch_url.description: Optional launch URL associated with the client.

logout_callback_urls.description: List of allowed logout callback URLs for the OIDC client.

name.description: The display name of the OIDC client.

pkce_enabled.description: Whether PKCE is enabled for this client. Defaults to true.

requires_pushed_authorization_requests.description: Whether this client requires Pushed Authorization Requests (PAR, RFC 9126). Defaults to false. Applies to confidential clients only — Pocket-ID coerces this to false for public clients (is_public = true). Enforced only by Pocket-ID versions that support PAR (v2.9.0+); on older versions the value is stored in state but not enforced.

requires_reauthentication.description: Whether this client requires reauthentication for certain flows. Defaults to false.

block.description:
Manages an OIDC client in Pocket-ID. OIDC clients are applications that can authenticate users through Pocket-ID.

~> **Note** The client secret is only available during resource creation and cannot be retrieved later. Store it securely.

custom_claims.description: Custom claims to include in the OIDC tokens of users in this group, as a map of claim name to value. Setting this attribute replaces all custom claims for the group. Reserved claim names (e.g. `email`, `groups`, `sub`) are rejected by Pocket-ID.

friendly_name.description: The friendly display name of the user group.

id.description: The ID of the user group.

name.description: The unique name identifier of the user group. This is used as the technical identifier and will be included in tokens.

block.description: Manages a user group in Pocket-ID. Groups can be used to organize users and control access to OIDC clients.

synced_at.description: Timestamp (RFC3339) of the most recent sync triggered by this resource.

triggers.description: Arbitrary map of values that forces a new LDAP sync when it changes. Typically wired to the LDAP configuration values so a sync runs whenever they change. If omitted, the sync runs only once (on create).

block.description: Triggers an LDAP synchronization in Pocket-ID. This is an action resource: applying it runs a sync, and changing `triggers` forces a new sync (the resource is recreated). LDAP must be enabled in the application configuration, otherwise the sync — and the apply — fails.

created_at.description: The creation time of the token in RFC3339 format.

expires_at.description: The computed expiration time of the token in RFC3339 format (created_at + ttl).

id.description: The unique identifier of the one-time access token (same as user_id).

token.description: The one-time access token value. Returned only on creation.

ttl.description: Lifetime of the token expressed as a Go duration string (e.g. `15m`, `1h`, `24h`). Must be greater than 1 second and at most 744h (31 days). Changing this forces a new token to be created.

user_id.description: The ID of the user this token belongs to.

block.description: Manages a one-time access token for a user in Pocket-ID. These tokens let a user authenticate when they don't have access to their passkey. The token value is returned only once on creation and cannot be read back (pocket-id exposes no read endpoint), so it is stored in Terraform state as a sensitive value.

client_id.description: The ID of the OIDC client this SCIM service provider configuration belongs to.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the SCIM service provider configuration was created.

endpoint.description: The SCIM endpoint base URL of the external service to provision to.

id.description: The unique identifier of the SCIM service provider configuration.

last_synced_at.description: The timestamp of the last successful SCIM synchronization.

token.description: The bearer token used to authenticate against the SCIM endpoint. This value is sensitive.

block.description: Manages the SCIM service provider configuration for an OIDC client in Pocket-ID. This enables Pocket-ID to provision users and groups to an external service via SCIM. Each OIDC client may have a single SCIM service provider configuration.

custom_claims.description: Custom claims to include in the user's OIDC tokens, as a map of claim name to value. Setting this attribute replaces all custom claims for the user. Reserved claim names (e.g. `email`, `groups`, `sub`) are rejected by Pocket-ID.

disabled.description: Whether the user account is disabled. Defaults to false.

display_name.description: The display name of the user. Computed from first and last name if not set.

email.description: The email address of the user.

email_verified.description: Whether the user's email address is verified. Defaults to false.

first_name.description: The first name of the user.

groups.description: List of group IDs the user belongs to.

is_admin.description: Whether the user has administrator privileges. Defaults to false.

last_name.description: The last name of the user.

locale.description: The locale preference for the user (e.g., 'en', 'fr').

username.description: The username for the user. Must be unique.

block.description:
Manages a user in Pocket-ID.

~> **Important** Users must complete passkey registration through the Pocket-ID web interface. This resource only creates the user account; authentication setup must be done separately.

ldap_skip_cert_verify.description: Whether LDAP certificate verification is skipped.
